transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Alex. I'm an existing customer and I'm interested in getting a mobile hotspot device. I have some travel coming up and need internet on the go.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You've definitely called the right place. We have some great options for mobile hotspots. I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I please have your Customer ID?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure thing. It's CUST, then the numbers 1031.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. And for security, could you please verify the 4-digit security PIN on the account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you. Let me just pull up your account here... One moment...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I have your account pulled up. I see you're Karen Davis, is that correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great, thank you for verifying that, Karen. I see you currently have our Fiber Gigabit Broadband internet service. We appreciate your loyalty.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, and it's been great. I'm hoping the mobile service is just as reliable.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm confident you'll be pleased. To make sure I recommend the right plan, can you tell me a little bit about what you'll be using the hotspot for during your travels?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Well, my husband and I bought a small RV and we're planning a few trips. It would be mostly for my laptop and my tablet. You know, checking emails, browsing websites, maybe streaming a movie in the evening.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That sounds wonderful! And that's exactly what these devices are perfect for. Based on that usage, especially with some streaming, I would recommend a plan with a good amount of high-speed data.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, what are the options?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We have a few tiers. Our most popular for travelers are the 'Explorer Plus' and 'Nomad Pro' plans. The Explorer Plus comes with 50 gigabytes of high-speed 5G data for $45 per month.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Fifty gigabytes... is that a lot? I'm not really sure how much I use.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a very common question. To give you an idea, 50 gigabytes is enough to browse the web for about 600 hours, or stream about 20 hours of HD video. For the usage you described, it should be more than enough for a few weeks of travel.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, okay, that does sound like plenty. What's the other plan you mentioned?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's the Nomad Pro, which is 100 gigabytes for $70 a month. It's for very heavy users, like people who work full-time from the road and do a lot of video conferencing.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, I don't think I'll need that. The 50 gigabyte plan sounds like the sweet spot. What happens if I go over?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great question. We don't charge overage fees. If you use all 50 gigabytes of your high-speed data, your connection speed is simply reduced for the rest of the billing cycle. It's still usable for email and basic browsing, just not ideal for streaming.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that's good to know. No surprise bills. I like that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. We believe in transparent pricing. So, the Explorer Plus plan with 50 gigabytes sounds like a good fit?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I think so. Now, what about the actual device?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Right. The device we offer for this plan is the Cymbal Go-Fi 5G Hotspot. It's a fantastic little piece of hardware.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Go-Fi, huh? Cute. Is it easy to use?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Very easy. It's about the size of a deck of cards, has a long-lasting battery—about 12 hours of continuous use—and it can connect up to 15 devices at once. You just turn it on, and it creates a personal Wi-Fi network, just like your router at home.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wow, 15 devices. It'll just be my laptop and tablet, maybe my phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's always nice to have the extra capacity. It uses our 5G network where available, and falls back to our 4G LTE network in other areas, so you get the best possible speed and coverage.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that sounds perfect. What's the damage? How much does the device cost?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You have two options for the device. You can purchase it outright for $240, or you can pay for it through a 24-month installment plan.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: An installment plan sounds better. How much would that be?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: With the installment plan, it's just $10 per month for 24 months, with 0% interest. It would be added right onto your existing Cymbal Telecom bill.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Ten dollars a month. I can do that. So my monthly bill would be the $45 for the plan plus $10 for the device?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. Your new monthly total for the hotspot service would be $55 plus any applicable taxes and fees.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Are there any other fees? Like an activation fee or something?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, that's a great question to ask. There is a one-time $35 activation fee for adding a new line of service. That would appear on your first bill after you activate the device.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, $35 one time. That's reasonable. This all sounds pretty good.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's a very popular and cost-effective way to stay connected while you're away from home.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Alright, Alex, you've convinced me. Let's do it. I'd like to order the hotspot with the installment plan and the 50 gigabyte plan.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent choice, Karen. I can place that order for you right now. Just to confirm one more time before we proceed...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're ordering the Cymbal Go-Fi 5G Hotspot on a 24-month installment plan at $10 per month. And you're adding the Explorer Plus mobile data plan, which is 50 gigabytes for $45 per month. You understand there will be a one-time $35 activation fee on your first bill. Is all that correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that is all correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. I need to confirm the shipping address. I show the address on file is the same as your service address for your fiber internet. Is that where you'd like the device shipped?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's the one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. I'm submitting the order now. This will just take a moment, please stay on the line with me.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Karen. The order has been successfully placed.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great! That was fast.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your order confirmation number is 8-6-7-5-3-0-9. I'm also sending a confirmation email to the address we have on file, which is karen.davis@telecom-personal.com.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay... 867-5309. Got it. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. Now, regarding shipping, we'll send it out via 2-day express. You should receive an email with the tracking number by the end of the day today. You can expect the device to arrive in about 2 to 3 business days.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's perfect. We're not leaving for another two weeks, so that's plenty of time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. When it arrives, the setup is very simple. The SIM card is already installed. You just need to power it on, and it will automatically activate on our network.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And how do I connect my laptop to it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It will create a Wi-Fi network that your laptop can see. The network name will be something like 'Cymbal Go-Fi' followed by a few numbers. The default password will be printed on a sticker on the back of the device.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that sounds easy enough. Just like connecting to Wi-Fi at a coffee shop.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Precisely. The included quick-start guide will walk you through it as well.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: One last question. When does the billing for this start?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Another great question. Your service and billing cycle will begin on the day you first power on and activate the device. So you won't be paying for any days it's sitting in the box.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, that's really smart. So I should wait to turn it on until I'm ready to use it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can, or you can turn it on at home just to make sure everything works to your satisfaction before you hit the road.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Good idea. I'll probably do that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And because of that, your first bill with the new charges might look a little different. It will have a pro-rated charge for the first partial month of service, plus the first full month in advance.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right, a pro-rated charge. I remember that from when I first got my internet. That makes sense.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. And it will also include the one-time $35 activation fee I mentioned. After that first bill, it will level out to the regular $55 plus tax each month.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You've been very clear, Alex. I appreciate you walking me through all the details.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's my pleasure, Karen. My goal is to make sure you have all the information you need and that there are no surprises. I'm happy we were able to get this all set up for you today.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Me too. I'm excited to try it out.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm sure it will be a great companion for your RV adventures. Was there anything else at all I could assist you with today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that was everything. You've answered all my questions.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. Well then, thank you for being a loyal Cymbal Telecom customer, Karen. I hope you and your husband have fantastic and well-connected travels.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you so much, Alex. You have a great day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You too. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Bye.
